source_facts.effectivity: Family drawing linked by exactproductpage; dimensions and105°C used as conservative bounds, not an assertion that all regional variants have identical qualification.

source_archive: Manufacturer webpages/PDF text inspected with web tool. Binary PDF download returned403; no nonexistent PDF archive is claimed. Exact URLs and numeric facts retained here.

controlled_geometry.slot_edge_finish: No burr; break sharp routed edges without reducing the specified minimum ligament.
controlled_geometry.tie_count_rule: One closed tie loop uses each pair of slots; only one locking head per loop. Park the head in either reserved side volume.
controlled_geometry.scope: Mechanical owner must bind these reservations to the final carrier. Max6mm harness is an installation requirement, not a measurement of the user harness.

F1_relaxed_exit.measured_from: Actual mated plug wire-exit plane, not PCB pin or carrier anchor.
F1_relaxed_exit.no_bend_tie_twist: First25.4mm free wire; no terminal bias.
F1_relaxed_exit.scope: External installation/service envelope. Actual plugexit and harness path unknown; no in-basic-box fit claim.

thermal_contract.reason_for105: Conservative resolution of exact product versus linked family drawing.
thermal_contract.CAN_wire_source: Current controlled Sumitomo AVSS0.3 specification,80°C/10000h; incomingOD1.30..1.50mm.
thermal_contract.CAN_routing: Use left anchor and keep actualwire≤80°C. Preserve15..25mm twist and≥30mm bend radius; F1 requires≥25.4mm relaxed exit before bend/tie/twist; ASC end≤15mm untwist. Do not flatten an unspecified length of twistedpair to fit the old2.8mm clearance.
thermal_contract.right_anchor: Can lie near90°C only with an accessory jacket rated for that localtemperature; adapterjacket material/rating is not inferred from the tie rating.

force_path.coax: External cablepull → SMA nut/shoulder → electrically insulating bulkhead → carrier mounting. U.FL socket is not the force anchor; righttie retains only the protectedservice loop. Bulkhead must restrain bothaxialdirections.
force_path.F1_harness: Each loaded conductor/jacket → controlledjacketgrip or specifiedintegralstrain-reliefshoulder → closedtie → carrier slotligaments → carrierfasteners. Anouterbundle tie doesnot byitself prove eachinnerwirecannot slip.
force_path.positive_shoulder_option: A molded/crimped harnessshoulder may replace friction credit only when itsattachment to the loaded wires is specified and rated≥20N at the actualtemperature. A loosecollar, tape buildup or anunbonded sleeve is not positivejacketretention. This optionalharnessfeature is not claimed present.
force_path.service: Disconnectpower and release ties before unmating. Maintainslack betweenanchor and F1/U.FL for permittedrelative motion, with the controlled30mm CAN bendradius envelope.

retention_model.conservative_friction_equation: For a round bundle tangent to the flat carrier, a strap contacting its lower arc between exits separated by s has contactangle theta=4*atan(D/s). Thus F_axial≤mu*T*theta. Use s≤7.9mm (6mm slotpitch plus1.7mm finishedslotheight maximum plus.2mm relative slotposition allowance); D is loaded/compressed diameter. T is retainedtension aftercreep/temperature, not gunsetting. No unconditionalpiwrap or2T normalforce is assumed.

nominal_design_target.meaning: The calculated target requires at least75% of the catalogue minimum loop strength under actual serviceconditions; thatretainedhotstrength is not guaranteed by the inspectedtable.

retention_model.jacket_damage_equation: For circular uniformband pressurep=2*T/(w*D). Requiredjacketallowablepressure must exceed the table value withoutcutting, extrusion or insulationdamage. Asoftspreader changespressure distribution and must be modeled withits actualfootprint.
retention_model.no_fabricated_properties: No frictioncoefficient, hotretention, jacketpressureallowance orinstalledtension is assigned to AVSS/PVC or the unknownaccessory merely to satisfy10N.

carrier_inverse_screen.scope: Simplified load-path demand, excluding edge stressconcentration. Actualcarrier material/temperature and edgegeometry must sustain these demands; flexural strength is not automatically a bearingallowable.

remaining_specific_acceptance: Actual assembledharness bundle≤6mm in the primarycorridor, everyloadedwirecaptured, preservedCANtwist/bendradius, and accessoryjacket diameter/temperature fit.
